106	        if (m && !m[1].includes('/core/rng') && !m[1].includes('_wwwcap')) {
107	          const lab = labelOf(m[1], Number(m[2]));
108	          if ((lab === 'JungleShrines' || lab === 'OceanCaves') && !midDone.has(lab)) {
109	            midDone.add(lab);
110	            capture(`m_${lab}`, storeRef, surfaceRef, chestsRef);
111	          }
112	          break;
113	        }
114	      }
115	    }
116	    return oReseed.call(this, s);
117	  };
118	  const t0 = Date.now();
119	  try {
120	    await generateWorld({
121	      width: W, height: H, seedText: String(SEED), evil: 0,
122	      onWorldPartial: (w, i, name) => {
123	        if (!storeRef) {
124	          storeRef = w.store as never as StoreLike;
125	          surfaceRef = (w as unknown as { surface?: Float32Array }).surface ?? new Float32Array(W);
126	        }
127	        // surface 是 GenCtx 的（不在 world 上）——槽末重算逐列首实心行即可（仅探针参考用）
128	        chestsRef = w.chests;
129	        capture(`s${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`, w.store as never as StoreLike, surfaceRef, w.chests);
130	        void name;
131	      },
132	    });
133	  } finally { RNGp.reseed = oReseed; }
134	  console.log(`captured ${capCount} boundaries in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s`);
135	}, 560_000);
136

268	  // (DFS 下邻优先),掷骰/判定序列不变。

390	export function runExposedGemsIcePass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
391	  // 冰系（:20842-20872）：y∈[(ws+rl)/2, lavaLine)、x=逐行雪界 snowMinX/MaxX[y]；

393	  // （cs:20855-20859 掷序），周边不对称窗口的空气格放晶簇
394	  for (let i = 0; i < st.w * 0.25; i++) {
395	    const y = rng.nextIntRange(Math.floor((gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2), gs.lavaLine);
396	    if (y < 0 || y >= st.h) continue;
397	    const minX = gs.snowMinX?.[y] ?? gs.snowOriginLeft;
398	    const maxX = gs.snowMaxX?.[y] ?? gs.snowOriginRight;
399	    // cs:20851：x 掷骰**无条件**（snowMinX/MaxX 只填到 lavaLine-140，未填带读默认 0

401	    const x = rng.nextIntRange(minX, maxX);
402	    const ii = st.idx(x, y);
403	    if (!st.flags[ii] || !ICE_FLOOR.has(st.type[ii])) continue;
404	    const wl = 1 + rng.nextInt(3);
405	    const wr = 1 + rng.nextInt(3);
406	    const wt = 1 + rng.nextInt(3);
407	    const wb = 1 + rng.nextInt(3);
408	    const style = randGemStyle(rng);
409	    for (let jx = x - wl; jx < x + wr; jx++) {
410	      for (let jy = y - wt; jy < y + wb; jy++) {
411	        if (jx < 40 || jx >= st.w - 40 || jy < 40 || jy >= st.h - 40) continue;
412	        const ji = st.idx(jx, jy);
413	        if (!st.flags[ji]) placeExposed(st, rng, jx, jy, style);
414	      }
415	    }
416	  }
417	}

422	  // 非地牢墙且墙≠27 → 单格（style=Next(12) 权重）——ExposedGemsUnderground 独立 pass
423	  // （新流起掷，与冰系段无关）
424	  for (let i = 0; i < st.w; i++) {

431	    const wl = st.wall[ii];

433	    placeExposed(st, rng, x, y, randGemStyle(rng));
434	  }
435	  // 琥珀（:20891-20913）：w 次，y∈[ws, h-300)，目标须空气+无岩浆+墙 187/216 →
436	  // 不对称窗口（各 1-3）的空气格放 style=6 晶簇。
437	  // 目标的 !active+!anyLava 门（cs:20901）曾缺失——实心沙岩也带 187/216 墙，
438	  // 命中率高一个数量级 → 琥珀簇 13× 金标（2026-08-12 用户标注）。
439	  for (let i = 0; i < st.w; i++) {
440	    const x = rng.nextIntRange(20, st.w - 20);
441	    const y = rng.nextIntRange(gs.worldSurface, st.h - 300);
442	    if (y < 0) continue;
443	    const ii = st.idx(x, y);
444	    if (st.flags[ii]) continue;
445	    if (st.liquid[ii] > 0 && st.liquidType[ii] === LIQUID_TYPE.LAVA) continue; // anyLava（+1 编码，勿写 0）
446	    const wl = st.wall[ii];
447	    if (wl !== 187 && wl !== 216) continue;
448	    const n14 = () => 1 + rng.nextInt(3);
449	    const al = n14(), ar = n14(), at = n14(), ab = n14();
450	    for (let jx = x - al; jx < x + ar; jx++) {
451	      for (let jy = y - at; jy < y + ab; jy++) {
452	        if (!st.inBounds(jx, jy)) continue;
453	        const ji = st.idx(jx, jy);

455	      }
456	    }

i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {\n  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;\n  if (typeof s === 'number') SHEET[i] = s;\n}\nconst REV = new Map<number, number>();\nfor (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {\n  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;\n  if (typeof s === 'number' && !REV.has(s)) REV.set(s, i);\n}\nconst DUMPNAME = new Map<number, string>();\nfor (const f of readdirSync(G2)) { const m = /^(\\d{3})_(.+)\\.typ$/.exec(f); if (m) DUMPNAME.set(Number(m[1]), m[2]); }\nconst gPath = (idx: number, ext: string) => `${G2}/${String(idx).padStart(3, '0')}_${DUMPNAME.get(idx)}.${ext}`;\nconst b8 = (idx: number, e: string) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));\nconst b16 = (idx: number, e: string) => new Uint16Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));\n\ninterface Boundary { gs: GenState; gensolid: Map<number, boolean>; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array; ids35: Map<number, number>; chests: unknown[] }\nfunction boundary(key: string): Boundary {\n  const dir = `${BDIR}/${key}`;\n  const gs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gs.json`, 'utf8')) as GenState;\n  const gensolid = new Map(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gensolid.json`, 'utf8')) as Array<[number, boolean]>);\n  const fw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/frames.bin`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const fx = new Uint16Array(N), fy = new Uint16Array(N), wire = new Uint8Array(N);\n  for (let q = 0; q < fw.length; q += 4) { const i = fw[q]!; fx[i] = fw[q + 1]!; fy[i] = fw[q + 2]!; wire[i] = fw[q + 3]! & 0x1f; }\n  const iw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/ids35.bin`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();\n  for (let q = 0; q < iw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(iw[q]!, iw[q + 1]!);\n  const chests = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/chests.json`, 'utf8')) as unknown[];\n  return { gs, gensolid, fx, fy, wire, ids35, chests };\n}\n\nconst EXPOSED = TILE_BY_KEY['v_178_gems']!;\nconst STONE = TILE_BY_KEY['stone']!;\nconst GEMMABLE = new Set<number>([0, 1, 40, 59, 60, 70, 147, 161].map((sh) => REV.get(sh)!).filter((v) => v !== undefined));\nconst GEM_WALL_BASE = 48;\nconst GEM_TILES = ['gem_amethyst', 'gem_topaz', 'gem_sapphire', 'gem_emerald', 'gem_ruby', 'gem_diamond'].map((k) => TILE_BY_KEY[k]!);\nconst ICE_COUNT = new Set<number>([147, 161].map((sh) => REV.get(sh)!));\n\nfunction solidTileAt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {\n  const i = st.idx(x, y);\n  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;\n  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];\n  if (!d) return false;\n  return !!d.solid && !d.platform && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;\n}\n\n(RUN ? it : it.skip)('iiii64 probe', () => {\n  const base = 63, out = 64;\n  const t = b16(base, 'typ'), a = b8(base, 'act'), wl = b16(base, 'wal'), lq = b8(base, 'liq'), lt = b8(base, 'lty');\n  const w4 = b16(out, 'wal');\n  const b = boundary('s18');\n  const st = new TileStore(W, H);\n  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {\n    const act = a[i]!;\n    st.flags[i] = act;\n    let id = 0;\n    if (act || t[i]) {\n      const sh = t[i]!;\n      id = b.ids35.has(i) ? b.ids35.get(i)! : -1;\n      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) id = REV.get(sh) ?? 0;\n    }\n    st.type[i] = id;\n    st.wall[i] = wl[i]!;\n    st.liquid[i] = lq[i]!;\n    st.liquidType[i] = lq[i] ? lt[i]! + 1 : 0;\n    st.frameX[i] = b.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = b.fy[i];\n    st.wire[i] |= b.wire[i];\n  }\n  restoreGenSolid(b.gensolid);\n  const rng = new RNG(SEED);\n  const gs = structuredClone(b.gs) as GenState;\n  const seenArr = new Uint8Array(N);\n  const visited: number[] = [];\n  const stackX = new Int32Array(4096);\n  const stackY = new Int32Array(4096);\n  const countTiles = (sx: number, sy: number): { air: number; lava: number; ice: number; rock: number } => {\n    let air = 0, lava = 0, ice = 0, rock = 0;\n    let sp = 0;\n    stackX[sp] = sx; stackY[sp] = sy; sp++;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n      if (air >= 300) break;\n      sp--;\n      const x = stackX[sp], y = stackY[sp];\n      if (x <= 1 || x >= W - 1 || y <= 1 || y >= H - 1) { for (const v of visited) seenArr[v] = 0; visited.length = 0; return { air: 300, lava, ice, rock }; }\n      const ii = y * W + x;\n      if (seenArr[ii]) continue;\n      seenArr[ii] = 1; visited.push(ii);\n      if (st.wall[ii] === 244 || (st.liquid[ii] > 0 && st.liquidType[ii] === 4) || st.wall[ii] !== 0 || (st.liquid[ii] > 0 && st.liquidType[ii] === 2)) {\n        if (st.liquid[ii] > 0 && st.liquidType[ii] === 2 && st.wall[ii] === 0) lava++;\n        for (const v of visited) seenArr[v] = 0; visited.length = 0; return { air: 300, lava, ice, rock };\n      }\n      if (st.flags[ii]) {\n        if (ICE_COUNT.has(st.type[ii])) ice++;\n        else if (st.type[ii] === STONE) rock++;\n      }\n      if (!solidTileAt(st, x, y)) {\n        air++;\n        stackX[sp] = x - 1; stackY[sp] = y; sp++;\n        stackX[sp] = x + 1; stackY[sp] = y; sp++;\n        stackX[sp] = x; stackY[sp] = y - 1; sp++;\n        stackX[sp] = x; stackY[sp] = y + 1; sp++;\n      }\n    }\n    for (const v of visited) seenArr[v] = 0;\n    visited.length = 0;\n    return { air, lava, ice, rock };\n  };\n  // vanilla 宝石墙腔集（golden 64）：wall∈[48,53] 的连通域粗分箱\n  const num = W * 0.003;\n  const sites: Array<[number, number, number]> = [];   // [sx, sy, tries]\n  for (let i = 0; i < num; i++) {\n    let sx = -1, sy = -1;\n    for (let tries = 0; tries < 1000; tries++) {\n      const x = rng.nextIntRange(200, W - 200);\n      const y = rng.nextIntRange(gs.rockLevel + 30, H - 230);\n      const c = countTiles(x, y);\n      if (c.air >= 50 && c.air < 300 && c.lava === 0 && c.ice === 0 && c.rock > 0) { sx = x; sy = y; sites.push([x, y, tries + 1]); break; }\n    }\n    if (sx < 0) continue;\n    // 池选（1+6 掷）\n    const gemOn = new Set<number>([rng.nextInt(6)]);\n    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) if (rng.nextInt(6) === 0) gemOn.add(k);\n    const randGem = () => { let n = rng.nextInt(6); while (!gemOn.has(n)) n = rng.nextInt(6); return n; };\n    const randGemTileId = () => (rng.nextInt(20) !== 0 ? STONE : GEM_TILES[randGem()]);\n    void randGemTileId;\n    void randGem;\n    // 简化 spread（只记腔覆盖,不真正写——掷流不再消费,后续 site 候选流仅供参考）\n    // → 改为真正跑 spread 的墙写,以保持流正确性\n    const seen = new Set<number>();\n    let frontier: Array<[number, number]> = [[sx, sy]];\n    while (frontier.length) {\n      const next: Array<[number, number]> = [];\n      for (const [x, y] of frontier) {\n        if (x <= 1 || x >= W - 1 || y <= 1 || y >= H - 1) continue;\n        const ii = st.idx(x, y);\n        seen.add(ii);\n        if (solidTileAt(st, x, y) || st.wall[ii] !== 0) {\n          if (!st.flags[ii]) continue;\n          if (GEMMABLE.has(st.type[ii])) st.type[ii] = randGemTileId();\n          for (const [dx, dy] of [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]] as const) {\n            const ni = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);\n            if (st.flags[ni] && GEMMABLE.has(st.type[ni])) st.type[ni] = randGemTileId();\n          }\n        } else {\n          st.wall[ii] = GEM_WALL_BASE + randGem();\n          if (!st.flags[ii] && rng.nextInt(2) === 0) {\n            // placeExposed 近似（掷对齐：CheckAndAdjust 成功才掷 2 骰）\n            let ok = false;\n            for (const [dx, dy] of [[0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1]] as const) if (solidTileAt(st, x + dx, y + dy)) { ok = true; break; }\n            rng.nextInt(3); if (ok) { rng.nextInt(3); }\n          }\n          for (const [dx, dy] of [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]] as const) {\n            const ni = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);\n            if (!seen.has(ni)) next.push([x + dx, y + dy]);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      frontier = next;\n    }\n  }\n  // 逐 site 与 golden64 对拍\n  sites.forEach(([sx, sy, tries], idx) => {\n    let van = 0;\n    for (let x = Math.max(0, sx - 100); x < Math.min(W, sx + 100); x++)\n      for (let y = Math.max(0, sy - 100); y < Math.min(H, sy + 100); y++) {\n        const wv = w4[y * W + x]!;\n        if (wv >= 48 && wv <= 53) van++;\n      }\n    console.log(`site#${idx} seed=(${sx},${sy}) tries=${tries} vanillaGemWall±100=${van}`);\n  });\n}, 560_000);\n"

function place3x2Pile(st, x, y, type, style): boolean {
  // Place3x2 (cs:52097) + PlaceTile case14/26/86-89/114/186/187 routing
  if (x < 5 || x > st.w - 5 || y < 5 || y > st.h - 5) return false;
  let ok = true;
  for (let c = x - 1; c <= x + 1; c++) {
    for (let r = y - 1; r <= y; r++) {
      if (st.flags[idx(c, r)]) ok = false;   // active → reject (Campfires liquid check 不适用)
    }
    // InvalidTileForPilesOrSpeleothems(c, y+1): active && Boulders
    if (invalidPiles(c, y + 1)) ok = false;
    if (!solidTile2(c, y + 1)) ok = false;
  }
  if (!ok) return false;
  const base = 54 * style;
  for (let c = x - 1; c <= x + 1; c++) {
    for (let r = y - 1; r <= y; r++) {
      const i = idx(c, r);
      st.type[i] = type; st.flags[i] = 1;
      st.frameX[i] = base + (c - (x - 1)) * 18;
      st.frameY[i] = r === y - 1 ? 0 : 18;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

129	      if (st.flags[i] && (st.slope[i] === 1 || st.slope[i] === 2)) {

131	        const leftSlope = s === 2 || s === 4;
